entities.name: PMID:25073966
observations: In 117 obese children in a 10-week lifestyle intervention (71 completed 12-month follow-up), change in sCD163 was associated with changes in ALT, HOMA-IR, hs-CRP, and cholesterol, and inversely associated with HDL change. Baseline sCD163 was higher with elevated ALT, steatosis, and high pediatric NAFLD fibrosis index.

entities.name: sCD163 intervention associations
observations: During lifestyle intervention in obese children, change in sCD163 correlated with changes in ALT, HOMA-IR, hs-CRP, cholesterol, and inversely with HDL; observational associations do not establish causality.
